title: Understanding the Effects of Optimal Combination of Spectral Bands on Deep Learning Model Predictions: A Case Study Based on Permafrost Tundra Landform Mapping Using High Resolution Multispectral Satellite Imagery.
summary: Deep-learning landform mapping is evaluated under optimized combinations of multispectral bands. Results compares landform mapping predictions across spectral inputs against reference labels; site-specific permafrost mapping result. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
